description: Spilling breaker of Ting & Kirby (1994): cnoidal waves H = 0.125 m, T = 2 s, relaxation generation over 4 m, 1:35 slope from x = 5.8 m, FNPF with A 350 4 (dx 0.025 m, 10 sigma layers). Breaking point = location of the maximum wave height from the gauges x = 1.8-29.9 m every 0.1 m, against the measured x_b = 6.40 m from the station d = 0.38 m (x = 6.5 m). The flume along y (fnpf_ting_kirby_spilling_y) must give the same wave heights.

reference.citation: Ting, F.C.K. & Kirby, J.T. (1994) Observation of undertow and turbulence in a laboratory surf zone. Coastal Engineering 23, 51-80 (spilling case H = 0.125 m, T = 2 s, 1:35 slope); breaking point x_b = 6.40 m from Derakhti et al. (2016) Table 1, see refdata/waves/ting_kirby_breaking/setup.txt
